design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Financial table: hairline rules between rows, bold header row, right-align numbers.
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a thin rule above and below, centred or left-aligned with a vertical bar.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, same accent colour for title, body in smaller serif.
No icons, no imagery, no bold beyond headers.
